title: Tower Legends now available on the Play Store
author: Traditional_End_743
selftext:
Hey everyone,

Tower Legends is now available on the Google Play Store!

It's a classic tower defense game with RPG elements, where each tower has its own skill tree with different abilities to unlock.

Enemies also evolve as you progress, gaining random abilities (shields, regeneration, stealth, etc.), so you have to adapt your strategy along the way.

The first 8 levels are free to play, and the rest can be unlocked with a one-time purchase. No ads or subscriptions.

It's been available on Steam for a couple of months, and I'm happy to finally have the Android version out too!

Here's the link if you want to give it a try:

Play Store: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.saradoc.towerdefense](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.saradoc.towerdefense)

Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5012660/Tower\_Legends](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5012660/Tower_Legends) with free demo available.

WebSite: [https://tower-legends.pdm.ovh/](https://tower-legends.pdm.ovh/) with browser playable demo.

Feedback is always welcome, especially on how the game feels on mobile!

Saradoc
